Nothing changes prod serving without Jean's approval. # Main result Same Modal B200 pod, prod R-1 (b200-b300-fold-44) and 1112 alternated, 300 s per level, n=5 runs per arm. Latency is per page. | Concurrency | prod pages/s | prod p50 / p90 / p99 (s) | 1112 pages/s | 1112 p50 / p90 / p99 (s) | 1112 / prod pages/s | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | C1 | 1.72 | 0.43 / 0.95 / 3.54 | 2.10 | 0.34 / 0.75 / 3.01 | 1.23x | | | C16 | 8.92 | 1.28 / 2.94 / 11.45 | 13.74 | 0.85 / 1.90 / 8.34 | 1.54x | | | C32 | 9.64 | 2.72 / 4.71 / 15.62 | 15.53 | 1.46 / 3.44 / 14.72 | 1.61x | | | C64 | 9.49 | 6.14 / 8.12 / 18.96 | 17.15 | 2.65 / 6.10 / 24.77 | 1.81x | |

- Speed gate PASS: at C16, p50 0.66x prod; at C32, p50 0.54x prod. p99 at C64 is higher than prod (24.77 s vs 18.96 s). - For reference, 1109 on 11-09 (another day, another pod): 1.93 / 14.30 / 16.48 / 18.63 pages/s at C1/16/32/64. C96 not measured. - Quality: judge vs BF16 nets -3 (prod fold-44 +2, 1109 was -6); head to head 1112 nets +6 over prod. No malformed markup on pages that stopped normally. # Current status - 🟢 Archived and checked: s3://reducto-shared-ml-workspace/external/fpp/fpp_35b-b200-2026-11-12/ (315 files; image tar sha256 001fb86c…68968f7). - 🟢 rep-1k offline A/B done (Main result above). - 🟢 Wide offline set (Jean's prod gate), 9,999 readable pages of v2_10k_quota_balanced_v1_pdf_pages, C16, one B200 per arm: PASS. Judge, 1112 vs prod: 99 wins / 9,817 ties / 83 losses, net +16 (bar -300), \$228.91. No request errors. | Arm | valid | malformed on normal stop | pages/s | p50 / p90 / p99 (s) | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | prod fold-44 | 9,954 | 2 | 8.02 | 1.44 / 3.25 / 10.24 | | 1112 | 9,955 | 5 | 10.16 | 1.20 / 2.69 / 6.23 | - 🟡 Autoeval: 1112 gets its own dev app fpp-flash-overshoot-1112 and domain full_page_parse_r1_overshoot_1112_replay ([#14671](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14671), per-candidate shadows); modal/dev untouched, 1109 retired with it. 🟢 Live since (prod workers e487f61115; sampler and cron from overlay f7af8586ee; R1 floor min 4 + buffer 2). 24 h gate ends . - Prod gate: wide set + ≥1 day autoeval before any prod recommendation. # Steps ## 1. Archive 🟢 - : archive started (315 files). One empty file failed the streamed multipart upload; reuploaded. - : all 315 files in S3; the 314 non-image files match SHA256SUMS. Against 1109, the engine changes 2 files (vision_attention_8bit.py, vision_fused.py) plus the reference outputs; the weights are the 1028 ones (1109 shipped a retrained encoder). - Uploading the package (no image tar) to HF branch overshoot-b200-20261112 of reducto/fpp_35b_20261028 (Jean's write token), as for 1109, so Modal can build it. ## 2. Offline A/B 🟡 - HF branch overshoot-b200-20261112 at 77996273 (314 files checked); weights on dev volume 20260901.inference at /2026/11/12/fpp_35b_overshoot_1112/weights. - Package selfcheck (shipped selfcheck.py --weights on a Modal B200): all 9 groups on; default mode 16/16 within the reference outputs, deterministic mode 16/16 identical. PASS. - rep-1k quality (C=CONCURRENCY driver, 1000 pages each): package 993 valid, 6 repetition stops, 1 length, 0 errors, 0 malformed (stop but rejected); prod fold-44 993 valid, 5 repetition stops, 2 length, 0 malformed. BF16 reference (pod-a, earlier run) 997 valid. - Speed (pods s1 prod->package x3, s2 package->prod x2; 300 s levels, n=5 per arm): prod fold-44 1.72 / 8.92 / 9.64 / 9.49 pages/s at C1/16/32/64; 1112 2.10 / 13.74 / 15.53 / 17.15 (1.23x / 1.54x / 1.61x / 1.81x). Speed gate PASS (C16 p50 0.66x, C32 p50 0.54x). 1109 on 11-09: 1.93 / 14.30 / 16.48 / 18.63 (other day). - Comparative judge (gpt-6.1-sol xhigh, rep-1k): BF16 vs 1112 11/975/14 (-3); prod vs 1112 14/978/8 (+6); BF16 vs prod fold-44 13/976/11 (+2). 1109 was -6 vs BF16. Inside the -30 bar. - Malformed markup through R-1's prod block parser: zero parse errors on stop-finished pages in any arm; every rejected page is a repetition/length stop (1112 7, prod 7, BF16 3). rep-1k can't resolve 1109's 0.57% prod regression; the autoeval shadow is the check. - Wide set (9,999 pages, C16, one B200 each; prod pod 20 min, 1112 16 min): | Arm | valid | rep. stops | length | stop but malformed | pages/s | p50 / p90 / p99 (s) | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | prod fold-44 | 9954 | 33 | 10 | 2 (0.02%) | 8.02 | 1.44 / 3.25 / 10.24 | | 1112 | 9955 | 30 | 9 | 5 (0.05%) | 10.16 | 1.20 / 2.69 / 6.23 | - Stop-but-malformed: 1112 2 inverted bboxes, 2 text outside blocks, 1 unknown q&a block; prod 1 empty, 1 q&a. Far below 1109's 0.57%. 0 request errors in both arms. Judge prod vs 1112 running. ## 3. Autoeval 🟡 - 11-12 11:45 AM PT: Jean wants 1112 as its own experiment in its own app. #14669 (shared-slot flip) closed in favor of [#14671](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14671). Deploy order: prod workers on #14671, dev app (warm min 4 / buffer 2), then sampler + cron from the overlay between :00 and :45. ## Status (11-12 4:50 AM PT) - PR [https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14630](https://github.com/reductoai/api/pull/14630): registers unpicked b200-1112-20; Devin Review round 1 fixed (hacky table arms, vllm import check). - Hold: modal/dev stays on 1109 until its soak drains (switch-off \~7:15 PM PT Nov 12 + 1-2 h; session 6822e20b). Then flip modal/dev + DEV\_PICK to b200-1112-20 (also on overlay devin/1794445000-autoeval-overlay-1109-soak), warm the dev R1 floor. Cron deploy is Jean's call. ## Status (11-12 7:15 AM PT) - #14630 merged (Jean). Its only FPP Flash redeploy was stg (fpp-flash v168 at fea64a0, 6:49 AM PT): healthy, serving 200s, staging inference smoke and integration tests passed. Picks unchanged: stg/prod/EU/AU on b200-b300-fold-44, dev on b200-1109-20. Prod/EU/AU not redeployed (manual prod deploy); the next one will roll fpp-flash once because r1.yaml changed, same pick. - Next: new PR flipping modal/dev + DEV\_PICK to b200-1112-20 once the soak session says the 1109 backlog drained (tonight PT). ## Impact - Offline, same B200 pod, prod package (fold-44) to 1112: 1.72 to 2.10 pages/s at 1 in flight, 8.92 to 13.74 at 16, 9.64 to 15.53 at 32, 9.49 to 17.15 at 64 (1.23x to 1.81x). - p99 per page: 11.45 to 8.34 s at 16 in flight, 18.96 to 24.77 s at 64 (worse). - Wide set, 9,999 pages at 16 in flight: 8.02 to 10.16 pages/s, p99 10.24 to 6.23 s; judge net +16 (bar -300). - Prod: the R-1 Modal prod pick is now b200-1112-20 (registry on main, read Nov 18). Prod pages/s and GPU cost per 1k pages before vs after that pick change: not measured yet. The SQLite table definition for this page's parent data source.
